description:
Sudoku, Nonogram, Minesweeper, Word Search & more. Calm puzzles, fully offline.

Quiet Grid is a calm collection of logic puzzles and word games: Sudoku, Nonogram, Takuzu, Minesweeper, Star Battle, Word Search, 2048 and more. No ads, no account, no internet. Everything stays on your device.

A FRESH PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Choose which games give you a new puzzle every day, in every difficulty. Share your result when you're done, and get an optional reminder if you haven't played yet.

JOURNEY
Work your way through chapters of puzzles that slowly get harder, and earn up to three stars at every stop. In 12 games.

PUZZLES THAT PLAY FAIR

  • Four levels, Easy to Expert, graded by the logic each puzzle needs, not by how many squares are empty.
  • Stuck? A hint shows you the next step.
  • Challenger mode: solve as many puzzles as you can before the clock runs out.
  • Build Mixes of your favorite games and difficulties and play them back to back.
  • Track wins, streaks and scores for every game and difficulty, with a full history of every puzzle you play.

LOGIC PUZZLES

  • Sudoku — Place digits 1–9 so every row, column and 3×3 box contains each digit once.
  • Killer Sudoku — No starting digits: the sums in each dashed cage tell you what goes where.
  • Mini Sudoku — Quick 4×4 and 6×6 Sudoku for a short break.
  • Takuzu (Binairo) — Fill the grid with 0s and 1s. Equal counts, no three in a row, no identical rows.
  • Nonogram (Hanjie) — Reveal a hidden picture using the number clues on each row and column.
  • Minesweeper — Uncover every safe cell without hitting a mine. Classic boards never need a guess, and there's an Endless mode.
  • Star Battle — Place stars in every row, column and region, with no two touching.
  • Animal Doku — One animal per row, column and colored region, never touching, not even diagonally.
  • Links — Join every pair of dots and fill the grid.
  • Circuit — Turn the tiles until every wire is live.

WORD GAMES

  • Word Search — Find hidden words in themed grids.
  • Word Guess — Guess the hidden word in six tries.
  • Guess by Numbers — Guess the word in ten tries; two numbers show how close you are.
  • Theme Clear — Spell words from one theme until every letter is used.
  • Word Swap — Swap letter tiles until every line spells a word.

MEMORY, NUMBERS AND BLOCKS

  • Chimp Test — Tap the numbers in order before they disappear.
  • Sequence Memory — Watch the pads light up, then tap the growing sequence back.
  • 2048 — Slide and merge tiles to reach 2048.
  • Block Fill — Drag pieces onto the board and clear full rows and columns. Includes an Endless mode.
  • Arrow Escape — Tap an arrow to send it off the board. It only gets out if nothing blocks its path.
  • Block Escape — Slide the blocks aside and set the coral block free.

MAKE IT YOURS
Seven color themes, including Pencil, a paper-like grayscale theme that works well for colorblind players. Star your favorite games, set hints, timer and layout per game, and continue a puzzle from a home screen widget. Play in 8 languages, and pick the language for word puzzles separately.

CALM, PRIVATE AND OPEN SOURCE
Made for calm puzzle time: time pressure only comes when you start Challenger mode yourself. No ads, no tracking, no account, and no internet permission. The only permission it asks for is notifications, for optional daily reminders. Open source under GPLv3.
